The '''Pomegranate''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] grown by planting a [[Pomegranate Sapling]], waiting 28 days for it to grow into a [[Pomegranate Tree]], and harvesting the tree during the [[Fall]].

A Pomegranate may be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|140}} or found in [[The Cave|The Farm Cave]], if the fruit bat option is chosen.

==Bundles==
*Pomegranate is used in the {{Bundle|enchanter||y}}. 
*Pomegranate is an option for the {{Bundle|Artisan||y}}.

==Recipes==
Pomegranate is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Pomegranate can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Relaxed Fit Pants]].  [[File:Relaxed Fit Pants.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Pomegranate is not used in any [[quests]].
